question_text: A 36-year-old woman presents with thyroid swelling. She has been healthy until now and follows all the healthcare precautions except for missing a flu shot this year. On physical examination, the thyroid gland is diffusely enlarged and tender to palpation. Laboratory findings show a decreased serum TSH level and elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate. Which of the following histopathologic findings would most likely be found in the thyroid gland of this patient?
